description: This file is a Node.js script that acts as a wrapper to normalize host options for the 'expo start' command in React Native development environments. It manages environment variables, sanitizes CLI arguments, determines the host mode, and spawns a child process to run the 'expo' CLI with the proper arguments.

methods.name: resolveHostMode()
methods.description: Determines the host mode ('lan', 'tunnel', 'localhost') based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeIncomingArgs(argv)
methods.description: Removes conflicting or invalid '--host' related CLI arguments from the input argument list.

methods.name: buildArgs()
methods.description: Constructs the CLI arguments array for 'expo start', including normalized host mode and platform flags.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Executes the script logic: sanitizes args, builds final command, and spawns the 'expo' process.
